text:
Alex Chen: hey folks — new hire question. macbook (Ventura) on home wifi + Redwood VPN (split-tunnel). I can't reach internal confluence (403) or kerberos services. Anyone seen this? wondering if it's a route priority thing or MTU.

Samir Patel: welcome! for split-tunnel we usually push 10.0.0.0/8 and internal DNS. can you paste `route get 10.0.0.1` and `scutil --dns` output?

Alex Chen: pasted the `route get` result — it shows interface en0 via gateway 192.168.1.1, vpn utun2 not selected. so looks like default route preference is winning.

Jen O'Neill: you can try a quick local workaround: `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.0.0/8 -interface utun2` on mac. that'll force the 10/8 traffic over the VPN until IT fixes the profile. also `networksetup -listallhardwareports` helps find the utun name.

Kevin Zhang: also flag MTU — home ISP might use 1500 while corp wants 1400, causing strange hangs. quick test: `sudo ifconfig utun2 mtu 1400` and retry.

IT Support Bot: Hi Alex — created ticket IN-2201 for network team, linking your box and MDM profile. We'll check the split-tunnel policy and push an updated route set via Jamf. In the meantime you can reach Confluence through the bastion: `ssh -J alex.chen@bastion.redwood.internal confluence.internal` or use an SSH tunnel: `ssh -L 8090:confluence.internal:80 alex.chen@bastion.redwood.internal` then open http://localhost:8090 in your browser.

Alex Chen: perfect — quick question: is bastion username the same as slack/email? I'm alex.chen@redwood.com

Samir Patel: yep, same creds. for cli you can also `ssh -J $USER@bastion internal-host` once your key is onboarded.

Jen O'Neill: :thumbsup: IT will push the fix, will update the onboarding doc with the utun/MTU notes. if anyone else hits this during first week, ping me and I'll add steps.

Alex Chen: awesome, thanks everyone! tagging @it for visibility :pray:
